content:
Leah: Quick thread to pick final speaker abstracts and lock run-of-show. Goal: 40m content + 15m Q&A. Need final abstracts (200 words) + 2-slide storyboards by Wed noon.
Omar: Can we tighten the abstracts to highlight the benchmark narrative? buyers respond to cost/latency tradeoffs.
Leah: yes each abstract should call out one benchmark datapoint (p50 latency or cost per 1k tokens) and one customer use-case.
Priya: Rehearsal ask: who wants a microlab (15m) vs full dress (60m)? I prefer microlab first.
Kai: microlab good. suggest week-before: microlabs Tue/Wed, full dress Thu morning.
Leah: good cadence. OpsBot, can you auto-create rehearsal invites when we claim slots?
OpsBot: sure. post your preferred 2-hour windows and I will create Zoom links + calendar events tagged #webinar-rehearsal.
Omar: Abstract note: please include 3 sample prompts (happy/edge/fallback) and the expected output snippet so we can add to the eval suite.
Priya: also include a one-line audience hook and CTA. e.g., "See cost/latency tradeoffs in a real app - live demo + checklist"
Kai: Run-of-show suggestion: 0-5m host intro + poll, 5-15m product framing, 15-35m two micro-demos (split), 35-45m panel/closing, 45-60m Q&A deep-dive.
Leah: I like that. add a 90s recorded fallback per demo in assets in case live stalls.
Omar: inbound lead routing question: after webinar, route attendees who clicked demo to SDR queue A, others to nurtures. Anyone object?
Priya: agree. we should tag attendees by behavior (clicked demo, asked technical question, attended >30m).
Leah: Metrics to track: registrant->attender %, live-demo-success %, MQL conversion by behavior segment, and demo-model fallback occurrences.
Kai: I'll make the tracker with columns: speaker, abstract_received, slides, prompts, expected_output, recorded_fallback, reheasal_slot, latency_p95, fallback_used.
Leah: final: speakers drop abstracts + assets by Wed noon and ping OpsBot with rehearsal windows. We'll confirm schedule by Thu AM. Thanks everyone :rocket:
